svg.title: NB57-GA-001 General arrangement and furniture layout

g.text: Dimensions in millimetres. Lengths from the aft face of the rear cabin bulkhead (datum, origin circle); heights from the underside of
Sections A-A and B-B are on the centreline and drawn in first-angle projection about the plan, so B-B is inverted with its baseplate
towards the plan and all lengths align. The plan is cut 1300 above the floor; items above the cut are dashed.
Finishes: walls ash-faced 9 ply; ceilings painted T&G; floors engineered oak (lobby, galley, saloon), carpet (bedroom), vinyl
(bathroom); solid oak worktops; bathroom walls painted T&G with PVC shower panels.
Stove: 4.5 kW multi-fuel on a raised non-combustible hearth projecting 225 in front and 150 each side; 25 calcium silicate shields on
10 air gaps; 125 flue; removable chimney (BS 8511, BSS).
LPG: 2 x 13 kg propane in the foredeck locker, opening to the outside only, drained overboard through 19 ID from its lowest point
above the waterline; cooker with flame-failure devices and a shut-off valve.
Safety: CO alarms to BS EN 50291 in the saloon and bedroom, smoke alarm in the galley, 5A/34B extinguishers at both exits and the
galley, fire blanket by the cooker. Exits: stern doors, bow doors and side hatch.
Concept general arrangement, not for construction. Scantlings, stability (ISO 12217-1, RCR category D) and systems to be confirmed by
GENERAL ARRANGEMENT AND FURNITURE LAYOUT: SECTIONS A-A, B-B AND PLAN
